title: Students surrounding a numbered robot in a lab space
objects_and_counts: At least 9 people (appearing to be students in school uniform) are visible standing in a semi-circle in the mid and background; the leftmost person is partially cropped at the image edge and several people are partially obscured by others.

One person in the right-central foreground (wearing a dark sweater over a white shirt) is holding a white hand controller or remote device with both hands; the controller is fully visible in their hands.

One mobile robot platform is visible on the carpeted floor in the central foreground; the robot assembly is complete and includes an illuminated horizontal light bar and front panel with a numeric label.

Two workbenches/tables with yellow tabletops have visible tabletop equipment and small items: the right-side table shows a keyboard and several small parts in plastic packaging; the left-side table edge shows stacked flat items and a plastic-wrapped bundle.
One open cardboard box is visible on the floor to the right of the right-side table; packaging material is visible inside or beside this box.
At least one backpack is visible (worn by or behind people) and at least one blue drawstring bag is visible being held by a student at right; both are partially obscured.
One tripod-like stand or camera support is visible behind the standing students near the center background, partially obscured by people.
